verdict.rationale: Copilot is itself a built-in assistant that takes delegated tasks. It is embedded in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook. Cowork handles multi-step tasks and delivers completed to-dos, and Browse with Copilot clicks, types and navigates in Edge with user supervision. One hands-on report says Copilot in Word could only append text and could not create tables or search-and-replace, which limits how much can be delegated but does not negate the capability; another user praises cross-document retrieval in 365. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Cowork's multi-step delegation scope, independent corroboration of agentic task completion, and evidence that in-app editing tasks work reliably.
